Class OffscreenMedia

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenMedia
public final class OffscreenMedia extends Object
Shared media declarations for native languages and ZenScript. Native/GL/audio classes are reached only inside the client bridge.

    • open

      public static OffscreenMedia.Player open(OffscreenWindows.Window window, OffscreenMedia.Source source, String kind, String ffmpegExecutable, OffscreenMedia.Options options)
      Starts asynchronous preparation owned by this exact window. Call play after retaining the handle.
      Parameters:
      window - native owner
      source - immutable encoded source
      kind - image, video or audio
      ffmpegExecutable - explicit installed FFmpeg path, or empty for built-in ImageIO/Java Sound decoding
      options - bounded output options
      Returns:
      owned player facade
